# Get Shortcut Details

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets a detail about a Shortcut.

## Syntax

~~~~text
shortcutDetail(detail: <#Enumeration (WFContentItemPropertyName)#>, input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
shortcutDetail(detail: Icon, input: shortcut)
~~~~
